sources.title: Iterative Reachability Estimation for Safe Reinforcement Learning
sources.review_notes: All 33 PDF pages (arXiv:2309.13528v1) were compared item by item with 150-170 dpi page renders (higher-resolution crops for the long proof displays on pages 15 and 19 and for every figure and the algorithm box) and with the authors' TeX source (main.tex, including its embedded bibliography). All inline and display mathematics was rewritten in LaTeX from the TeX source with private macros expanded; all 43 extractor 'formula' images were replaced by display blocks, with \tag for the three named equations (CMDP), (RCRL), (RESPO) and the eleven numbered ones (1)-(11). Three scripts in the scratch directory support the visual review: texcompare.py (all 606 math snippets identical to the macro-expanded source after whitespace removal; two differ only by the braces of the colour groups), prosecompare.py (all prose runs occur contiguously in the source except text generated by cross-references, the algorithm and the appendix letters) and wordcheck.py (per-page multiset of words of four or more letters equals that of pdftotext apart from figure labels inside crops, math glyphs and the omitted page furniture). Definitions 1-5, Theorems 1-2, Propositions 1-2, assumptions A1-A3 and the appendix restatements (printed as Theorem 3, Proposition 3, Proposition 4, Theorem 4) carry their printed labels in bold; statement ends were taken from the TeX environments. Algorithm 1 is an image crop plus a line-by-line transcription. Figures 1-14 are complete image crops (edges checked on crops; appendix Figures 7-14 in supp_figs) with verbatim captions; Tables 1-2 (appendix) are CSV tables with Unicode cells and a marked LaTeX note. Page-break sentence joins on pages 2-3, 4-5, 8-9, 9-10 and 15-16; floats printed in the middle of a sentence (pages 9, 10) were reordered within their page. The 60 references were generated from the embedded bibliography and each compared with the PDF. Omitted regions: the vertical arXiv stamp and the NeurIPS footer on page 1 and the printed page numbers 2-33. Authors' typos and inconsistencies are kept and listed in the page review notes and in the conversion notes. Review was done by one agent; no independent second verifier was used.
